## Description

Performs Riemannian manifold metric diffusion over Symmetric Positive Definite (SPD) covariance matrices to evolve optimal risk-parity portfolio weights smoothly across economic cycles.

## Where it may fit

Risk-parity asset allocation, macro regime shifts, multi-asset portfolio rebalancing.

## Vehicles

Institutional Risk-Parity Funds, Multi-Asset Endowment Portfolios.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, macroeconomic feature panels, risk budget vectors.

## Caveats

Riemannian exponential and logarithmic map operations require careful numerical precision checks.
